content: COM is a website that provides reference content through more than four million entries, which have been aggregated from various sources. The platform was officially launched in January 2005. It serves as the flagship product of the Answers Corporation, a company that was formerly known as GuruNet. GuruNet was an Israel-based internet reference company with operational offices located in both New York City and Jerusalem. The company was originally founded by Bob Rosenschein in 1999. The Answers Corporation also owns WikiAnswers, a question-and-answer platform that utilizes a wiki-based engine to refine and enhance the quality of questions and answers. WikiAnswers is recognized as the second-largest Q&A site, following Yahoo. Answers. The Answers Corporation has expressed its intention to integrate the two platforms more closely. This integration aims to deliver a diverse range of answers to its users, encompassing both encyclopedic information and community-driven responses.
